sources.name: Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures
sources.why: Defines adverse impact and the four-fifths rule at 1607.4(D). The threshold every AEDT bias audit depends on.

sources.name: EEOC regulations implementing the ADA
sources.why: Disability discrimination; governs accessibility of automated screening.

sources.name: EEOC regulations implementing the ADEA
sources.why: Age discrimination; relevant to models trained on tenure or graduation-year features.

sources.name: Guidelines on Discrimination Because of Sex
sources.why: Sex discrimination guidance under Title VII.

sources.name: Guidelines on Discrimination Because of National Origin
sources.why: National-origin discrimination; relevant to name and language features.

sources.name: EEOC Recordkeeping and Reporting
sources.why: Record retention obligations that bias audits depend on.

sources.name: OFCCP Uniform Guidelines (mirror of UGESP)
sources.why: Near-duplicate of 29 CFR 1607. Deliberately included: near-duplicate documents are a known retrieval failure mode and the harness should measure it.
